Lee’s Garden

Find bouquets of sunflowers, lilies, and dahlias at Lee’s Garden. Owners Yang Lee and Bee Thao have been a fixture in Pike Place Market for nearly 30 years.

The Market's page

No city business licence matched this name at a market address. Daystall craftspeople and farmers trade under the Market's own permits, which the city's licence file does not carry.
